GERMAN P. SARANA, JR. Mayor Bayawan City, Negros Oriental Dear Mayor Sarana, Jr. : DILG Legal opinion No. 39, S. 2014 09 DEC 2014 This refers to your 26 July 2014 request for opinion concerning the intention of your City to allocate 10% of its 70% Local Disaster Risk Reduction Management Fund (LDRRMF) pursuant to an undertaking as member of an alliance organized through a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) among LGUs of Southern Negros composed of four (4) cities and seven (7) municipalities, i.e., the Southern Negros Disaster Management Alliance (SONEDMA), on the basis of Section 12 (c) (20)2 of Republic Act No. 10121 (RA 10121). Allegedly said contribution will be utilized for training, purchase and installation of an automatic "early warning system" with online access to all members of the Alliance, purchase of rescue equipment, fuel and lubricants for rescue operations and closely related activities. Please be informed that in a letter dated 14 November 2014, the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) opined that under Item 5.2 of NDRRMC-DBM-DILG Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2013-1 (hereinafter, the "Circular"), an LGU may utilize the non-QRF portion Of their LDRRMF for certain projects/activities related to disaster preparedness. The DBM noted that the activities of SONEDMA appear to be aligned with the projects/activities related to disaster preparedness under Item 5.2, particularly Items 5.2.3 & 5.2.6, of the Circular, viz: "As mentioned in your letter, the contribution of member cities and municipalities of the SONEDMA shall be used for the following purposes: • Traming • Purchase and installation of an automatic early warning system with online access to all members of the Alliance • Purchase of rescue equipment, fuel and lubricants • Other related activities 2 Section 12. Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (LDRRMO).-xxx (c) The Provincial, city and municipal DRRMOs or BDRRMCs shall perform the following functions with impartiality given the emerging challenges brought by disasters Of our times: (20) Establish linkage/network with other LGUs for disaster

Under NDRRMC-DBM-DILG Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2013-1, an LGLI may utilize [he non-QRF portion of their LDRRMF for certain projects/activities related to disaster preparedness like the following: Item 5.2.3 Item 5.2.6 Development of information, education and communication campaign (IEC) campaign and information sharing between LGUs/communities and the national government Development and institutionalization of early warning system, information sharing among LGUs/communities and the national government Considering that the activities of SONEDMA appear to be aligned with the above mentioned projects/activities, the non-QRF portion of the LDRRMF may be tapped by Bayawan City to cover its contribution to the SONEDMA." Notwithstanding the foregoing, please exercise prudence in committing a fixed portion of your LDRRMF for disaster preparedness as it may compromise your City's capacity to provide for other activities related to the three other areas of disaster risk reduction and management. Attached is a copy of the 14 November 2014 letter of DBM Secretary Francisco B. Abad, for your reference. Thank you. Very truly yours, STERE A. PANADERO Undersecretary DILG-OUSLG 2014-12-03823 Dir.
